# Microsoft Learn

> Microsoft Learn is a comprehensive learning platform offering free technical training, certifications, and documentation across cloud computing, AI, and Microsoft technologies.

The platform provides structured learning paths, hands-on training modules, professional certifications, and community support for developers and IT professionals building skills in Azure, AI, and Microsoft products. It serves as both a documentation hub and a career development resource with interactive courses and applied skills credentials.

## Key Topics

- Azure
- Microsoft Copilot
- Generative AI
- AI Fundamentals
- Cloud Computing
- Microsoft Certifications
- Skill Development
- Azure Fundamentals
- .NET
- Microsoft 365
- Applied Skills
- Career Growth
- AI Training
- Beginner Guides
- Microsoft Fabric

## Core Learning Hubs

- [Microsoft Learn Homepage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us): Main portal for technical skill development and certifications
- [Azure Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure): Comprehensive Azure cloud services documentation and tutorials for developers
- [Technical Documentation Index](https://learn.microsoft.com/docs): Central documentation hub for .NET, Azure, C++, and Microsoft development tools
- [AI Learning Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/ai): Structured learning for Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, and practical AI skill development
- [Microsoft Copilot Learning Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot): Training and deployment resources for Microsoft Copilot across products

## Certifications & Credentials

- [Professional and Technical Credentials](https://learn.microsoft.com/credentials): Directory of Microsoft Certifications and Applied Skills credentials
- [Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) Course](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/courses/ai-900t00): Certification course with hands-on exercises for Azure AI fundamentals
- [Azure Fundamentals Learning Path](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/paths/microsoft-azure-fundamentals-describe-cloud-concepts): Cloud concepts learning path preparing for AZ-900 certification exam
- [Student Certifications Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/student-hub/certifications): Student certification programs and Azure training with special discounts

## Training Modules

- [Introduction to Generative AI and Agents](https://learn.microsoft.com/training/modules/fundamentals-generative-ai): Beginner module covering generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents fundamentals

## Community & Support

- [Microsoft Q&A Community](https://learn.microsoft.com/answers): Community question and answer platform for technical support on Microsoft products
- [Experts Hub Contributor Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/contribute): Guide for contributing content and joining the Microsoft Experts Hub community
- [Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge Lifecycle FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/faq/internet-explorer-microsoft-edge): Frequently asked questions on lifecycle policies for Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge

## Optional

- [Principles for AI-Generated Content](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/principles-for-ai-generated-content): Microsoft's policy on AI-generated content and responsible AI practices
- [Previous Versions Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions): Archive of legacy documentation for deprecated Microsoft product versions
- [Terms of Use](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/termsofuse): Legal terms of use and user agreement for Microsoft Learn platform
